paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.21% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.13%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.16%). Brent crude changed +1.92% to 110.91. Gold changed -2.42% to 4,049.7. Bitcoin changed -0.57% to 80,850.9375. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.993%, a relative move of -2.42%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (-9.06%) and HSBC (-7.26%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Shares of Ambani’s Jio rise 21% in India’s biggest IPO (FT World). Telecoms business raises $3.2bn at $108bn valuation in relief to stock market hit by war in Iran Deals and capital markets: Buyout firm EQT acquires German diagnostics group in €10.8bn deal (FT Markets). Move for Germany’s Qiagen is one of the largest take-private transactions in Europe this year Central banks and macro: Israeli central bank rejects Netanyahu’s plan to use crypto to evade sanctions (FT World). Critics say prime minister’s proposal would turn country into an economic pariah Central banks and macro: UK September inflation fuels expectations of imminent BoE rate rise (FT World). Headline and core inflation accelerates ahead of November meeting Geopolitics and trade: How a transatlantic mega-merger fell apart over a leadership tug of war (FT Companies). Smith & Nephew was in talks to combine with J&J’s orthopaedics unit but refused to agree to former CEO leading combined business
